Short answer: we have one confirmed headcount slot for Infra as of the Nov 18 headcount reconciliation; slot is reserved for hires with start dates through Dec 31. I can provide written confirmation to attach to the offer.

On the 409A/grant timing: a couple of compliance points to keep in mind —
- Grant date should not be earlier than the effective date of the 409A valuation we rely on. For quarterly valuations we typically use the most recent (Q3) report dated Sep 30; a new special-purpose valuation will be required for a grant date after Sep 30 and before the next regular valuation date.
- Wilson Valuations can produce a special-purpose valuation with a short turnaround, but we need to issue the PO today/tomorrow and accept their fee estimate (I attached the Q3 summary for context). If we want a Nov 30 grant, we must confirm Wilson by EOD tomorrow.

Recommendation: send the offer today with language that the equity grant is "anticipated" and subject to final board approval and 409A effective date. If board signs on Nov 30 and Wilson completes valuation by Dec 3, we can set an effective grant date of Nov 30 (or Dec 1) retroactively with appropriate board minutes/consent. If not, set grant to candidate start (Dec 6).
